note: 交換留学生 (JMdict ent_seq 2103860, sense 0) is glossed exchange student and is more precise than 留学生, which includes any student studying abroad.
先生 is the ordinary Japanese title for a teacher or master and naturally addresses a martial arts instructor; the specified martial arts setting narrows the role.
スーツ (JMdict ent_seq 1066680, sense 0) is glossed suit (clothing) and is the modern gender-neutral term for an office business suit; 背広 is older and usually men's clothing.
現在 (JMdict ent_seq 1263650, sense 0) is glossed the present, present time, and now; 今度 usually means this time or next time.
に and để are the natural functional equivalents in purpose constructions such as in order to; their parts of speech differ, but the construction matches the stated function.
再開 (JMdict ent_seq 1292400, sense 0) is a する-verb glossed resumption and restarting; 再開する is the precise natural verb for resuming after a pause.
特有 (JMdict ent_seq 1455370, sense 0) means characteristic of or peculiar to, matching a feature specific to a person or thing better than 特別.
変更 (JMdict ent_seq 1511040, sense 0) is glossed change and modification; it covers a changed form without implying a correction as 修正 often does.
運ぶ (JMdict ent_seq 1172660, sense 0) is glossed to carry, transport, move, and convey; it is more general than 持って行く, which adds going somewhere.
要素 (JMdict ent_seq 1546800, sense 0) is glossed component and factor and fits a phenomenon contributing to an outcome without implying it is the primary cause.
一式 and bộ are natural terms for a purpose-specific set or kit; the English definition describes a collection assembled for a particular use.
金属 (JMdict ent_seq 1243040, sense 0) is directly glossed metal and avoids the common money reading of 金 (かね).
たった今 (JMdict ent_seq 1632090, sense 0) is an adverb glossed just now and a moment ago, matching moments ago better than the ところ verb pattern.
外見 (JMdict ent_seq 1203520, sense 0) is glossed outward appearance and looks; 様子 usually describes a broader state or condition.
một đêm expresses one night as a counted occasion or event, closer to an evening spent at an activity than general đêm.
まで and đến are standard equivalents for up to a time; the supplied temporal definition distinguishes them from their spatial uses.
遠吠え (JMdict ent_seq 1178370, sense 0) is glossed howl and is used as a する-verb; it specifically suits the long mournful call of dogs or wolves.
ヨット is the standard Japanese word for a yacht, and du thuyền is the standard Vietnamese equivalent; the definition's motor use can describe an auxiliary engine.
噂話 (JMdict ent_seq 1983920, sense 0) is glossed gossip and more directly denotes talk or rumors about other people than broader 噂.
不正 is glossed injustice and unfairness, and bất công is the normal Vietnamese word for the absence of justice described here.
議長 (JMdict ent_seq 1226140, sense 0) is glossed chairperson and presides over assemblies or councils; 委員長 is specifically a committee chair.
小屋 is a natural Japanese word for a cabin or hut, including a small simple dwelling; the frontier-log detail is supplied by the stated sense.
笛 and sáo are standard broad names for flute-like woodwind instruments, and both can refer to a recorder as specified here.
吠える is the common verb for a dog barking, and sủa is the natural Vietnamese equivalent for the short loud animal vocalization described.
かけっこ is a natural word for an informal footrace or sprint, which matches the stated foot-race sense even though it often suggests children.
現在 (JMdict ent_seq 1263650, sense 0) means the present, present time, and now; 今回 means this time or this occasion instead.
状況 (JMdict ent_seq 1356700, sense 0) is glossed situation, conditions, circumstances, and state of affairs; it is more neutral than 事情.
舞台 can denote a stage performance or production, and the listed Japanese glosses directly include play and theatrical production for this English sense.
帯 (JMdict ent_seq 1410410, sense 2) is glossed band, belt, and strip; it conveys a long narrow band more directly than generic-piece 切れ.
刑 (JMdict ent_seq 1249610, sense 0) is glossed penalty, sentence, and punishment; 判決 primarily means the court's judicial decision.
時期 means a period or phase, not youth or young adulthood; that definition does not yield a direct translation of the English headword time with matching sense.
セキュリティ usually names a secure state, system, or measures, not an object that itself secures something; no clear single Japanese equivalent is established.
辞める is the common Japanese verb for quitting or resigning a job, and từ chức is the Vietnamese equivalent for resigning from office; status comes from context.
群れ and bầy are natural words for a group or pack of animals; the English definition supplies the hound or dog context.
蒸気機関車 (JMdict ent_seq 1707230, sense 0) is directly glossed steam locomotive and avoids 汽車's broader modern use for a train.
響き is a natural noun for an echo or reverberation, matching both senses stated in the English definition.
円周 (JMdict ent_seq 1175860, sense 0) is the precise Japanese noun glossed circumference; 周り is generally around or surroundings.
辺境 (JMdict ent_seq 1512100, sense 0) is glossed frontier and border district, fitting a country's border region better than general 境界.
漫画 is a natural Japanese term for comics and comic strips; a strip is a format within the broader medium described in the English definition.
ひげ covers beard and moustache but not eyebrows, while lông mặt is awkward Vietnamese; the English definition combines unlike facial-hair categories without a good natural single equivalent.
